key.name: layout-json
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, and desktop positions as JSON.

key.name: edit-mode
key.description: Enable widget edit mode to move and remove widgets on the desktop.

key.name: custom-photo
key.description: Absolute path to a photo to display in the Photos widget instead of the automatic selection. Leave empty to use the automatic rotating photos.

key.name: photo-size
key.description: How the photo fits the widget: cover (fill and crop), contain (entire photo visible), fill (stretch), or small (centered). Allowed values: cover, contain, fill, small.

key.name: battery-icon-size
key.description: Size of the device icon inside each battery ring: small, medium, or large.

key.name: battery-slot-count
key.description: Maximum number of devices shown in the Battery widget.

key.name: battery-show-percent
key.description: Show the charge percentage below each battery ring.

key.name: screentime-retention-days
key.description: Number of days of per-app screen time history to keep. Data files older than this are deleted automatically.

key.name: arrange-widgets
key.description: Set to true to align all widgets into a shared grid of columns and rows. The extension performs the arrangement and resets the key to false.

key.name: music-ignore-browsers
key.description: Prevent browsers like Chrome or Firefox from taking over the music widget.

key.name: music-empty-gif
key.description: Animated GIF shown by the music widget when no track is playing. Allowed values: pushy.gif, pushy2.gif, pushy3.gif, pushy4.gif, pushy5.gif.

key.name: music-custom-app
key.description: Desktop app ID launched when the Music widget is clicked. When set, it takes priority over the built-in list of music players. Leave empty for default.

key.name: calendar-weekday-format
key.description: How weekday labels appear in the calendar header. Allowed values: short (Mo Tu We) or narrow (M T W).

key.name: digitalclock-hour-format
key.description: Time format for the Digital Clock widget. Allowed values: 24 or 12.

key.name: digitalclock-show-seconds
key.description: Show seconds in the Digital Clock widget. Only available in the 2×1 and 2×1 mini sizes.

key.name: digitalclock-show-ampm
key.description: Show the AM/PM indicator next to the time in 12-hour format.

key.name: edit-mode-binding
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut to toggle edit mode on the desktop. Leave empty to disable.

key.name: github-use-green
key.description: Use GitHub's default green color scheme instead of the theme accent color for contribution cells.

key.name: github-username
key.description: GitHub nickname used by the GitHub Activity widget. Applies to all GitHub widgets. Empty to set a username per widget by clicking it.

key.name: style-border-radius
key.description: Corner radius for the widgets.

key.name: style-border-width
key.description: Border width in pixels.

key.name: style-background
key.description: Custom CSS background color. Leave empty for default.

key.name: style-border-color
key.description: Custom CSS border color. Leave empty for default.

key.name: style-shadow
key.description: Custom CSS box shadow. Leave empty for default.

key.name: style-shadow-size
key.description: Blur radius of the custom box shadow in pixels.

key.name: style-widget-opacity
key.description: Global opacity of all desktop widgets, from 0.1 (nearly invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque).

key.name: style-use-custom-accent
key.description: Override the system accent color with a custom color for all widgets.

key.name: style-accent-color
key.description: Custom CSS accent color used by all widgets when custom accent color is enabled. Leave empty to use the system accent color.

key.name: style-light-glass
key.description: Apply a light glass effect to all widgets with transparency and blur.

key.name: style-light-glass-blur
key.description: Blur radius of the light glass effect in pixels.

key.name: style-light-glass-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the light glass background, from 0.1 (nearly transparent) to 1.0 (fully opaque).

key.name: drag-active
key.description: Internal flag set by the preferences window while a slider is being dragged, used to defer widget re-rendering until the drag ends.

key.name: notes-title-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the Notes widget title.

key.name: notes-content-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the Notes widget content text.

key.name: widget-gap
key.description: Space between widgets and screen edges (0-50px)
